tests.name: hsvaToHsla converts black (s=0, v=0) to l=0, s=0
hsvaToHsla converts white (s=0, v=100) to l=100, s=0
hsvaToHsla converts a mid-gray (s=0, v=50) to l=50, s=0
hsvaToHsla converts fully saturated, full value color (s=100, v=100) to s=100, l=50
hsvaToHsla converts fully saturated green at half value (s=100, v=50) to s=100, l=25
hsvaToHsla uses the hh <= 100 branch for a moderately bright, low-saturation color
hsvaToHsla uses the hh > 100 branch (denominator becomes 200 - hh)
hsvaToHsla matches a precise non-round example in the hh > 100 branch
hsvaToHsla returns s=0 when hh equals 0 (v=0 regardless of s)
hsvaToHsla returns s=0 when hh equals 200 exactly (s=0, v=100)
hsvaToHsla returns s=0 when hh exceeds 200 (s negative, which is out of normal range)
hsvaToHsla passes the hue through unchanged, including out-of-range values
hsvaToHsla passes the alpha channel through unchanged
hsvaToHsla does not clamp s or v itself, leaving that responsibility to clampHsla
hsvaToHsla is a pure function that does not mutate its input
